reviews.text: I feel very well, the service it was excellent, thanks.

Dr. Marquez seen my pet and suggested a surgery that was going to cost over 11k.  When we asked if there were any other options as it was such a large amount she responded very cold, and said “it is what it is” and shrugged us off.  There was no sympathy for the financial burden this was going to cause us.  After we were assured that my dog would be having surgery that night or the next day, we called to check on him and they told us they had no surgeons until possibly next week!  That was also going to cost 4500 more per day that our dog was there.  I don’t think that this clinic cared one bit about pet care.  If you’re looking to get overcharged, ripped off, and treated horribly then go there.   The one saving grace was the front desk associate who helped with my refund of 8k.

The consultation with Dr. Venable was fantastic.  She was thorough and thoughtful.  I was amazed at how she put her hands on Chloe and got a good sense of her joints, muscles, etc.  We also talked about diet, and she really educated me about food.  We chose foods that support Chloe's weight-loss goals.  I left feeling confident about the path forward and Chloe's condition.  Chloe had a hydro treadmill session with Lisa the next day.  Once again, I was delighted and impressed with the knowledge and care shown.  Top-notch across the board. Dr. Venable, seriously, one of the best vet visits I have ever had.  I am really grateful.
Lisa was great for the water treadmill session.  I didn't know what to expect and she made it all smooth.
All the staff were great.   The consulation was outstanding.  The water treadmill session was also a positive experience for me and Chloe.

I've been going to 1st Pet ER clinic for emergencies only and recently had to take one of my cats for UTI over a weekend.  The staff and vet Dr. were all good, took the time to explain what procedures they would do and gave me an estimate of charges.  Post her visit there, they provided me clear instructions on how to take care of her at home, they called me twice to follow up and sent all the records to my own vet. clinic to follow up.  Over the years, I've taken my dogs to for emergencies and even for euthanasia and all the Drs. and staff have been caring.  I understand that vet care can be expensive, but that is the cost of caring for your fur babies for their life.

1st Pet Veterinary Centers has provided extraordinary care and compassion for each of my dogs over the past several years since moving to North Phoenix.  My recent visit was excellent and efficient.  I really appreciate the services provided here.  Fast, efficient, very friendly, and clean.  5 stars.
This is hard because the front desk, the Techs and the doctor were just fabulous! BUT, it was 6 hours before we got out of there. Only one doctor on Sunday so it's a very very very long wait.
Great experience with my Jack Chi

First pet vet has been a great place for our dog because she is happy to see them and we are happy that we get to be in same room with our dog during entire exam. Dr and assistants very knowledgeable and kind and helpful in meeting our dog's needs but ours too. A very friendly place for everyone who works there. Is expensive though but since we have pet insurance we feel they have our dogs back if anything major should happen to her.

They were able to get me in right away and did a great evaluation with my dog and were very caring. They were also fair priced as well with well explained options that were broken down to allow me to understand the choices that I had as far as what was going on with my pup and treatment plans.

Thank you for taking such great care of Deborah. She means the world to us and finding an emergency Veterinarian (Dr. Just) who was kind and compassionate is truly rare. Both technicians and both of the CRS were so friendly, accommodating and knowledgeable. We will continue to use their facility for our urgent needs. Thank you again.
